cyclic_chordless.note: cyclic_chordless c: every host edge between two entries of c joins cyclically consecutive entries (seq_cyclic_consecutiveb); no distinctness premise, which sg_edgeNeq makes redundant.

cyclic_chordlessb.note: Boolean mirror of cyclic_chordless quantified over the list; reflected by cyclic_chordlessP.

chordless_ucycle.note: chordless_ucycle c: a chordless ucycle of host adjacency with no length bound (D2str's raw contract); the empty list and the two-vertex cycle of an edge qualify.

chordless_cycle.note: chordless_cycle c: a chordless ucycle with 2 < size c, a genuine induced cycle (X91, XE1); equivalent to seq_cycle (--) c /\ cyclic_chordless c.

hole.note: hole c: a chordless ucycle with 3 < size c (X3, X27); a triangle is a chordless cycle but not a hole.

chordless_ucycleb.note: Boolean mirror of chordless_ucycle; reflected by chordless_ucycleP.

chordless_cycleb.note: Boolean mirror of chordless_cycle; reflected by chordless_cycleP.

holeb.note: Boolean mirror of hole; reflected by holeP.
